risk_summary: The disclosure combines quantified operating improvements and optimistic forecasts with extensive generic forward-looking disclaimers and a broad catalog of real-estate, financing, insurance, environmental, and control risks. Risk tone is moderately positive operationally, but exposure to leverage, refinancing, uninsured losses, market conditions, and execution uncertainty remains material. Repeated safe-harbor language and non-update disclaimers reduce specificity regarding downside scenarios.
